_about: Visible strings emitted by the server/boot layer (app/(english)/_families/*): consent notice, language switcher, IST clock prefix, newsletter form markup, newsletter double opt-in email and confirm/unsubscribe pages (lib/newsletter-copy.ts; served by the API routes from l10n/generated/<locale>.json ui), no-JS notice. Injected per locale as window.__AHV_T (English source -> translation) and read by boot.ts; one unit each.
